audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer was written against a version of Aurelion Sol that no longer exists. 'Voice of Light (R)' appears in seven fields and 'Starfire Spin (W)' in two — neither is in his kit. His abilities are Cosmic Creator (P), Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), Singularity (E) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/aurelionsol.json slot names; packet.defects flags that the matchup 'never names any of Aurelion Sol's abilities'.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one, with the numbers attached: Breath of Light 3s at 750, Singularity 12s at 750, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1, Falling Star 120s at 1250.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was described as 'his kit is short-ranged and reactive' with no mechanism. The real lever is that both his lane tools sit at 750 while Breath of Light is a CHANNEL — any Hwei crowd control cancels it outright.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol kit: Q range 750, channel flag 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'; E range 750; Hwei's Q and E both carry hardCC.
audit.corrected: You out-range him by a wide margin and you own an off-switch for his damage; the lane is yours at every stage as long as you dodge Falling Star.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer put Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item on 'Skill' and 2+ items on 'Aurelion Sol', while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei on all seven rows. phases[6].why described Hwei opening the fight under a row that said Aurelion Sol won it.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Hwei x7 and matches win[0..6]; Falling Star is 120s at rank 1 and Hwei's R out-ranges it, 1300 to 1250.
audit.corrected: All seven rows Hwei, with each why grounded in the number that makes it true.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity's two defining properties were nowhere on the page: it deals percent-health damage and its centre EXECUTES below a threshold, and Cosmic Creator's Stardust is permanent.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol kit E flags percentHealth and execute plus text 'executes enemies who are below a certain p...'; P text 'permanently improves each of his abilities'.
audit.corrected: Never fight standing in the black hole regardless of your health bar, and treat every kill he gets as a permanent power gain.

audit.why: Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Singularity 12 flat, Falling Star 120/110/100, Breath of Light 3.

notes: This matchup was written against the pre-rework Aurelion Sol. 'Voice of Light (R)' appeared in seven fields and 'Starfire Spin (W)' in two; neither ability exists. His kit is Cosmic Creator, Breath of Light, Astral Flight, Singularity, Falling Star / The Skies Descend — which is also exactly what packet.defects reported ('never names any of Aurelion Sol's abilities'). Every one is now named with its real number. Three interactions reached the page for the first time: Breath of Light is a CHANNEL and any Hwei CC cancels it, Singularity deals percent-health damage and executes at its centre (so health stacking is the wrong answer), and Cosmic Creator's Stardust is permanent, which is why feeding him is worse here than the usual 'he gets ahead' framing. Level chart: the full layer had Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item on 'Skill' and 2+ items on 'Aurelion Sol' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei on all seven; phases[6].why even described Hwei opening the fight under an Aurelion Sol row. I moved the full layer onto the already-correct content layer, so no paired win[N] edit was needed. Ratings untouched.
